t: A free, open source screen reader for blind and low vision users on Windows.
steps: Download the installer from the NV Access website.
Ask IT to approve the install on school machines.
Check that the computer is 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 with 4 GB of RAM.
Install NVDA or run the portable copy from a drive.
Choose a voice and a language in the settings.
Connect a braille display if the student uses one.
Practice basic keys with the student before class.
